Duong di cua mot lenh qua Tomasulo: issu: The path of an instruction through Tomasulo: issue into a reservation station and the ROB, execute, broadcast on the CDB, then commit from the head of the ROB
đủ 2 toán hạng là chạy, bất kể thứ tự: runs as soon as both operands arrive, in any order
CDB — bus dùng chung, mỗi chu kỳ chỉ 1 k: CDB — shared bus, only 1 result broadcast per cycle
ROB — giữ mọi lệnh đang bay, ĐÚNG thứ tự: ROB — holds every in-flight instruction, in PROGRAM order
Commit từ ĐẦU ROB — đúng thứ tự: Commit from the ROB HEAD — in order
hoặc squash: xoá sạch, như chưa từng chạ: or squash: wiped, as if never run
chỗ trong ROB đặt ngay lúc issue: ROB slot reserved at issue time
Chỉ hai đầu là đúng thứ tự chương trình: Only the two ends follow program order — issue and commit. Everything in between is free to be as disorderly as it likes, and that is where the speed comes from.
